---
title: "unicorn/no-unreadable-array-destructuring"
description: "Disallow array destructuring that skips two or more values in a row"
# Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit below this line.

In `const [,,, year] = parts`, you have to count commas to know which element you get, and it's easy to miss one comma too many or too few. Read the element by its index instead.

Skipping one value at a time is fine.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"unicorn/no-unreadable-array-destructuring" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 2} */}
```js
const [, , , year] = match;

function area([, , width, height]) {
  return width * height;
}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```js
const year = match[3];

function area(box) {
  return box[2] * box[3];
}

const [, month] = match;
const [first, , third] = match;
```
